description: This file defines the SerialPortException class used for handling exceptions related to serial port operations in the jSSC library.

classes.name: SerialPortException
classes.description: Custom exception class for serial port errors, including static error type strings and context information (port name, method name, exception type).

methods.name: SerialPortException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with port name, method name, and exception type.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port involved in the exception.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method during which the exception was thrown.

methods.name: getExceptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of exception as a string.
